You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How many days will it take Lauren to create all of the picture scenes? Lauren can draw 5 large-sized picture scenes per day. Lauren can draw 6 medium-sized picture scenes per day. Lauren can draw 7 small-sized picture scenes per day. Lauren was hired to create 45 large-sized picture scenes, 36 medium-sized picture scenes, and 49 small-sized picture scenes.
